description: Every maritime chokepoint with a published daily ship count (Suez, Panama, Hormuz, Malacca and more), lowest share of normal first, then those unknown or not rated: slug, name, the unit counted, status (open, elevated, disrupted, closed, not_rated when too few ships a day to judge, or unknown), the mean of the last 7 calendar days to latest_date as a share of normal, normal and the newest day behind it, and a link to its page on gaduin.com. Counts are published in batches several days in arrears (weekly; Panama monthly): latest_date is the newest day counted, not today.
name: list_chokepoints
title: Maritime chokepoints
